description: The pie chart presents the distribution of relation categories in the MMRA benchmark, showing 11 slices in total, each labeled with a count and percentage. The slices are: ObservationAngle in mint green at 126 (12.28%); SimilarMaterial in orange at 106 (10.33%); SubEvent in coral/red at 100 (9.74%); UsageSimilarity in salmon at 100 (9.65%); Environment in teal at 90 (8.77%); Layout in pale yellow at 90 (8.77%); AppearanceSimilarity in light green at 90 (8.77%); SimilarEvent in light blue at 90 (8.77%); MentalitySimilarity in light cyan at 89 (8.67%); RelativePosition in light gray at 81 (7.90%); and NearSameEntity in dark gray at 63 (6.34%). Percentages and counts are printed directly next to the corresponding slices, there is no separate legend, no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the slice sizes visually follow a generally decreasing pattern from the largest (ObservationAngle) to the smallest (NearSameEntity).
